name: radial-meter
title: Radial Meter
description: Concentric progress arcs nestled in recessed chassis wells with central telemetry readout and calm status indicators.

props.name: series
props.description: Array of concentric metric series with id, label, value (0-100), and color

props.name: size
props.description: Square dimensions of meter canvas in pixels

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Thickness of each concentric arc track in pixels

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Subdued uppercase title displayed in the central well

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Primary value displayed in central well (defaults to average)

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Renders breakdown legend pills below the meter

examples.title: Multi-Tier Cluster Telemetry
examples.description: Three concentric series monitoring compute, memory, and storage utilization.
examples.code:
<RadialMeter
  centerLabel="Total Load"
  series={[
    { id: 'cpu', label: 'CPU Compute', value: 74, color: 'var(--text-primary)' },
    { id: 'ram', label: 'RAM Cache', value: 89, color: 'var(--text-muted)' },
    { id: 'io', label: 'Disk IOPS', value: 52, color: 'var(--border)' },
  ]}
/>
